description: Fork of exp141 (E=64, out_proj nap=6, 316.5M, final 1.7250). Replace single-layer unembedder LN(384)->Linear(384,vocab) with 2-layer MLP: LN(384) -> Linear(384, 1536) -> ReLU -> Linear(1536, vocab). concat_dim = N_LAYERS*E = 6*64 = 384. Hidden = 4*concat_dim = 1536. Param add: ~38M (12.6M -> 50.9M unembedder). Total: ~355M. Tests whether the bottleneck is at the unembedder — exp141 has 6 LUT layers feeding 384 dims into a single linear-to-vocab; an MLP unembedder gives the model more flexibility to mix layer outputs nonlinearly before producing logits.
